segments.contextBefore: The code below creates a Metal layer for content in the BT.2020 color space using the PQ transfer function:
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let metalLayer = CAMetalLayer()
metalLayer.wantsExtendedDynamicRangeContent = true
metalLayer.pixelFormat = .bgr10a2Unorm
let name = CGColorSpace.itur_2100_PQ
metalLayer.colorspace = CGColorSpace(name: name)
```
